channel.title: SIGIL — Signal Intelligence Lab
channel.description: Investigative analysis of Portuguese public procurement patterns

item.title: SUCH Serviços Hospitalares: Expansões de Contrato de 11.000%
item.description: Contratos de serviços de suporte hospitalar atribuídos por ajuste direto aumentaram de alguns milhões para centenas de milhões de euros através de modificações pós-contratação, contornando completamente os limiares competitivos.

item.title: Siemens / Infraestruturas de Portugal: 109 Ajustes Diretos
item.description: O gestor de infraestruturas ferroviárias de Portugal atribuiu 109 contratos em ajuste direto à Siemens para sinalização e manutenção, criando um bloqueio de fornecedor sistemático sem licitações competitivas na relação.

item.title: Elsevier / FCT: 15-Year, €120M+ Monopoly
item.description: Portugal's science agency has awarded 137 contracts to Elsevier for academic library access over 15+ years, all via direct award, with steadily escalating prices from €17.6M to €24M per cycle.

item.title: Dentsu / Turismo de Portugal: Pipeline de Incumbência
item.description: €20M in direct award contracts to Dentsu for tourism marketing preceded a €40M competitive tender for the same services, raising questions about incumbency advantages.

item.title: Cleaning & Security Services: 397 Direct Awards Above Threshold
item.description: Commoditized facility services with many qualified providers are being awarded via direct award above €500k. Fine Facility alone holds 871 government contracts.

item.title: Contrato Modifications: Systematic Price Jumps
item.description: 25,672 contract modifications since January 2025. CP Comboios (+€318M), Metro do Porto (+74%), and multiple Infraestruturas de Portugal projects show repeated expansions suggesting systematic cost underestimation.

item.title: EU-Wide Pattern: €110B+ Flagged, 80% Direct Awards
item.description: Cross-referencing Portuguese procurement on the EU TED portal reveals systemic issues: over 80% of procedures are direct awards, 20% have single bidders, and academic research confirms deliberate contract value manipulation to stay below competitive thresholds.

item.title: Corporate Networks: Director Interlocks & Shell Indicators
item.description: Corporate registry analysis of flagged BASE suppliers reveals director interlocks across major Portuguese companies, shell company structures at shared addresses, and opacity in beneficial ownership — classic red flags for procurement collusion.
